explication: GestaltEdit is an on-device iOS/iPadOS utility for changing MobileGestalt capabilities and fields, with backup, import, export, and restore. The main workflow is user edits or selects presets in the UI, the view model stages changes, and GestaltAccess reads, writes, and verifies the system plist; backups preserve the original data. A separate launch-time command supports setting the Siri AI US-region values. Some source excerpts are partial, so uncertain UI-to-respring wiring is omitted.
